title: Cardinal Billing Account Standing Rule: Returned-Payment Addition to the Installment Charge
content:
**Rule.** A returned-payment addition is added to the installment charge on a Cardinal Billing Account installment invoice: **$2.00** when two or more payments on the account were returned in the last 12 whole months, **$1.00** when exactly one was, and none when none was. The addition is a dollar amount added to the relieved charge; it is not itself multiplied by any rate.

A window of the last 12 whole months holds every record posted less than 12 whole months before the invoice date, counted on calendar months. A returned payment is a returned-payment entry on the account's billing history.

| Returned payments in the last 12 whole months | Addition |
|---|---|
| 0 | None |
| 1 | $1.00 |
| 2 or more | $2.00 |

**Hypothetical figure.** A relieved charge of $1.20 on an account with two returned payments in the window becomes $3.20 with the addition.
